name: site
description: The real site built on Quartz Core: the workspace package the site loads its plugins through. Repo-only: never published (CONTEXT.md).
//dependencies: Every plugin the site and the e2e fixture list by package name, linked from the workspace: the shareable plugins in plugins/, and the site plugins in site-plugins/, which are repo-only (#96). Quartz imports a package source by name from Core source, and Node's upward walk from quartz/core/quartz/ reaches this package's node_modules, so Core's own package.json stays upstream's (#89, #93, VENDORED.md). Only the fixture's own plugins, in tests/fixture-plugins/, load by local path. A package the site lists more than once, each entry placing a component somewhere else, is here again under an alias, that entry's placement name: Quartz loads an object source `{ repo, name }` whose repo is a package by importing its `name`. So `email-subscribe-sidebar` is @chaoticgoodcomputing/quartz-email-subscribe, and `site-page-title` and `site-footer` are @chaoticgoodcomputing/site-components (VENDORED.md).
